channel.title: Unattended
channel.description: Practical guides to running AI automations that keep working while you sleep.

item.title: Claude Code Hooks Examples: 7 Copy-Paste Scripts
item.description: Claude Code hooks examples you can copy: 7 working scripts for guardrails, Stop-hook stall prevention, and usage logging, with settings.json and fixes.

item.title: Claude Code: How to See Token Usage (and Reduce It)
item.description: Claude Code how to see token usage: run /usage in a session, read total_cost_usd from headless JSON runs, check the Console Usage page, and set cost alerts.

item.title: Claude Code Hooks Lifecycle: Every Event, Explained
item.description: Claude Code hooks lifecycle explained: when each hook event fires in an automation run, and which ones stop runaway token use or silent failures.

item.title: Claude Code Cron Job Setup: Run Automations Overnight
item.description: Claude Code cron job setup: auth tokens, PATH, working directory, permissions, locks and log rotation, so overnight claude -p runs don't fail silently.

item.title: Claude Code Checkpoints: How Rollback Works in Automations
item.description: How Claude Code checkpoints work in headless jobs: enable SDK file checkpointing, save UUIDs, rewind unattended runs, and learn what rewind can't undo.

item.title: Why Claude Code Stops Mid-Automation (and How to Fix It)
item.description: Why does Claude Code stop running headless automations? Map the turn, budget, timeout and permission triggers in claude -p runs, plus a fix checklist.
